description: President Secretariat - Amendment, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2153/12 of 10th December 2019 Duties and Functions
categorisation: This gazette contains both the naming of a specific individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities being assigned to ministers (Minister of Defence and Minister of Power & Energy). It specifies exact subject matter responsibilities, departments, and legislation under each ministry, meeting the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) classification as it includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
